name: MET
summary: A rare psychedelic tryptamine related to DMT and DET. There is little known information about this drug, further research is highly recommended.

pharmacology.text: As with most psychedelic tryptamines, MET is thought to act principally as a 5-HT2A partial agonist. The psychedelic effects are believed to come from MET's binding efficacy at the 5-HT2A receptors. However, the role of these interactions and how they result in the psychedelic experience continue to remain elusive.

uses.text: Today, it is either used recreationally or as an entheogenic substance and has been exclusively distributed by online research chemical vendors since mid-2016.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Psychedelic tryptamines can cause nausea, anxiety, confusion, a faster heart rate and raised blood pressure, and may trigger psychosis in people prone to it.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。迷幻色胺類可能引起噁心、焦慮、混亂、心跳加快與血壓上升，也可能誘發易感者的精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。迷幻色胺类可能引起恶心、焦虑、混乱、心跳加快与血压上升，也可能诱发易感者的精神病。

fact.en: MET sits between DMT and DET: it has one methyl and one ethyl group on its nitrogen. Shulgin described it in TiHKAL.
fact.zh: MET 介於 DMT 與 DET 之間：它的氮原子上接著一個甲基和一個乙基。舒爾金在《TiHKAL》中描述過它。
fact.zhHans: MET 介于 DMT 与 DET 之间：它的氮原子上接着一个甲基和一个乙基。舒尔金在《TiHKAL》中描述过它。
